rfp_requirements.title: Develop and deliver QA Plan
rfp_requirements.description: QA Manager shall lead efforts to develop and deliver a QA Plan to the SCM for review and approval.

rfp_requirements.title: Bid Solicitation requirements and State's final decision prevail in QA Plan disagreements
rfp_requirements.description: If there are any disagreements on what the QA Plan should include, the requirements of this Bid Solicitation and the State's final decision will prevail.

Task B: Quality Assurance and Oversight Activities for the I/M Program
Compliance activities assure the integrity of the I/M Program, and we will meet all the requirements outlined in Task B:
Quality Assurance and Oversight Activities for the I/M Program. Our auditing infrastructure and depth of experience
create a strong foundation for comprehensive, reliable oversight activities for the I/M Program. We will provide
PennDOT more immediate access to oversight activity results while ensuring our operations support PennDOT’s
needs and requirements. Dasher will support Program integrity through remote visual and covert audits.
Our team, with guidance from PennDOT, has developed and will provide a Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC)
program that complies with 40 CFR § 51.353, 51.369, 51.366, and 75 Pa. C.S. § 4707. This program has ensured
consumer protection against fraud through equipment, inspector, record, and station audits. We perform the described
oversight activities on all I/M stations in Pennsylvania, regardless of their location, unless otherwise directed by
PennDOT.

AUDITING AND ADMINISTRATION SERVICE, QA/QC: Parsons was responsible for the integrity of the program’s
network of more than 2,000 facilities and thousands of counter staff, emissions inspectors, and repair technicians. Our
team provided a successful and seamless implementation when rolling out program changes or new testing equipment.
We provided consistent program oversight and support and handled compliance auditing through a combination of
regularly scheduled overt, covert, telephone, and real-time video audits, along with drop-in visits. Penalties and
sanctions for noncompliance were designed around an escalation process based on a thorough and impartial
investigation.
Field visits with our personable and helpful field technicians provided us with a great working relationship with the
facility owners and staff in the industry, as reflected through our customer satisfaction surveys and regular touchpoints.
Our expert and reliable field technicians performed tasks during implementation that included providing program-
branded signage and training, to program au

ed a sophisticated QA/QC risk-based compliance-monitoring system to improve
compliance of the program by identifying facilities with a high risk of failing to comply with requirements and
regulations. Through automated data analysis processes, our real-time data-analysis and test-interruption system is
highly effective in identifying suspect facility activity in the program. Our system continually monitors and analyzes
millions of rows of data. By using effective data triggers, we can identify data anomalies, determine which irregularities
are in violation of program rules, identify statistical patterns that indicate potential noncompliant acts, and suspend
test or repair activity while awaiting further review, all in real time.
Parsons’ proven data analysis methods are supplemented by real-time test interruptions. Our expert technicians review

Testing equipment maintenance, including kiosk maintenance, is paramount to ensuring a smooth operating
program. Parsons’ inspection application requires that periodic maintenance is performed frequently and
timely ensuring constant smooth operation. All data is tracked on the VID and recorded. Program
stakeholders may review and monitor station equipment status easily and centrally.
Proper maintenance of equipment increases the lifespan of hardware in the field, reduces downtime, and
increases Program acceptance. All equipment maintenance plans provided will follow the manufacturer’s

needs. A partnership with Parsons is not a 9 to 5 proposition, we’ll respond when you need us or the
circumstances dictate our response.

every layer. Parsons AWS architecture consists of redundant systems and services duplicated across two
availability zones within a region.
